_comment: Synthetic two-chiller plant (generator chw_plant_multi, camber/datasets/_synthetic_chw_plant_multi.py; 0.105, #145) -> CAMBER Role mapping for the secondary chilled-water loop, its own equipment beside the two chillers. SEC_SWT / SEC_RWT are the secondary supply (downstream of the decoupler) and return in F, CHWS_SP the plant's supply setpoint in F, SEC_GPM the secondary flow in gpm, SEC_PUMP_SPD the secondary pumps' speed in % and SEC_PUMP_KW their power in kW (0 while the plant is off), OAT the outdoor dry-bulb in F. The pumps' power is the loop's generic power role, as on lbnl-chiller's SECPUMP; the chilled-water rules read it as the loop's run signal.
